body_markdown:
AmpliTech Group is excited to be attending The Fast Mode Awards at LiveX in Kuala Lumpur, January 25 -26, 2027. The Fast Mode LiveX Kuala Lumpur 2027 is 2-day industry summit that explores how AI and intelligent digital infrastructures will redefine next-gen connectivity and experiences.


AmpliTech Group was named a 2026 Open RAN Champion for Innovation at the 2026 Fast Mode Awards on November 3, 2026, recognizing AmpliTech’s achievements in the innovation dimension of Open RAN. Other recipients within the Open RAN Champion category include Capgemini for Performance, Rakuten Symphony for Impact and P.I. Works for Growth.[Read more here.](https://www.amplitechgroup.com/news/amplitech-group-named-2026-open-ran-champion-for-innovation-at-the-fast-mode-awards/)


[Will you be there? Send us a note today to schedule a meeting with us.](https://www.amplitechgroup.com/contact-us/)
